app.name: Traversi
app.subtitle: Reverse-Budgeting Travel Recommendation Engine for Malaysian Youth

hero.title:
You Enter Your Budget,
Traversi Finds the Fit.
hero.description: Over 70% of travelers exceed their budget because flight tickets are only half the picture. Traversi computes total costs: return flights, shared hotel rooms, daily halal meals, and local ground transport from day one.

problem.title: Why Do Independent Travelers Overspend?
problem.p1: Booking platforms display flights for RM280, but ground expenses easily exceed RM2,000 without realizing it.
problem.p2: Travelers juggle 4 different apps: one for flights, one for hotels, one for visa rules, and one for halal food spots.
problem.p3: Not a single commercial tool starts from your wallet's perspective.

pillars.title: Engineered for Malaysian Travelers
pillars.pillar1Desc: Far beyond just flights. We compute return airfare, shared twin rooms, daily halal food, and rideshare transport.
pillars.pillar2Desc: Live OpenStreetMap halal query integration paired with Malaysian passport visa regulations without guesswork.
pillars.pillar3Desc: Carefully balanced day-by-day itineraries tailored for youth pacing, culture, and memorable food spots.

kalkulator.title: Reverse-Budgeting Calculator
kalkulator.subtitle: Specify your maximum budget, trip duration, number of travelers, and preferred vibe.
kalkulator.resultsSubtitle: Ranked by highest savings and trip satisfaction.
kalkulator.noResults: No destinations found within this budget. Try increasing budget or adjusting trip length.
kalkulator.roomShareNote: Hotel rooms calculated on twin-sharing basis (ceil(pax/2))
